A statement is given followed by two courses of action numbered I and II. A course of action is a step or administrative decision to be taken for improvement, follow up or further action in regard to the problem, policy, etc. On the basis of information given in the statement, you have to assume everything in the statement to be true. Decide which of the given courses of action logically follow(s) for pursuing.Statement:Violence erupts in 12 districts of a major state during filing of the nominations for municipal elections.Courses of Action:I. The Government should immediately take steps to safeguard the EVM machines.II. The Government should immediately take steps to ensure safety of candidates who are filling nominations.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Only II follows) है।
